The petitioners through this petition are seeking pre-arrest bail by reference to provisions of Section 438 A of the Cr.P.C 1973 with respect to the FIR no. 0081/2022 dated 01.11.2022 registered by the Police Station, Chassana, District Reasi for the alleged offences under sections 341, 323, 376-D, 382/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The registration of the FIR at the instance of the respondent no. 3.
Status report has come to be filed by the SHO Police Station, Chassana.

The status report dated 03.12.2022, from the SHO Police Station concerned reflects that it is in the back-drop of the some land dispute that the registration of the FIR no. 0081/2022 in reference came to take place and after registration of the FIR no. 0081/2022, the prosecutrix or for that matter any of her relatives are staying away from getting themselves examined for reasons which are not even known to the concerned Police Station.
This Court deems it fit to have latest status report along with objections to the present bail application from the SHO, Police Station concerned.

Till the filing of the fresh status report along Pushkar Nath And Others vs Ut Of J&K And Others on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108566090/

sentences.text: , the petitioners are granted interim pre-arrest bail.

In the event of the petitioners are subjected to arrest by the SHO/Investigating Officer with respect to FIR no. 0081/2022, they shall be admitted to pre-arrest interim bail subject to the following terms and conditions:
a) That the petitioners shall make themselves available for the investigation purpose as and when required, by the Investigating Officer;
b) That the petitioners shall furnish personal bond to the amount of Rs. 2,00,000/-
each with one surety of the like amount before the Investigating Officer.

c) That the petitioners shall not directly or indirectly make any attempt to interfere and intermeddle in many manner whatsoever in the cause of investigation in the case and shall not attempt to temper with witnesses in the case.
d) That the petitioners shall not leave the UT of J&K without the prior written permission of the SHO concerned.
This interim direction to last only till next date of hearing.
